name: guest-reviews
description: Check whether an Airbnb review can be removed and draft a removal request from your evidence. Use pasted reviews, messages and exports to check removal grounds, requester roles and request history, and prepare a source-linked evidence packet with supporting and contrary facts.

interface.shortDescription: Assess review removal and prepare evidence
interface.longDescription: Check whether an Airbnb review can be removed and draft a removal request from your evidence. Works from pasted text and selected readable exports. Checks policy grounds, requester roles, pending requests and the two-submission limit; prepares a factual draft and evidence index.
defaultPrompt: Can this Airbnb review be removed? Here are the review, messages and my request history.
Organize this evidence and draft a supported review removal request.
